author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 9th of April of 2023, my family went out for dim sum lunch in the elegant Fisherman's Terrace Seafood Restaurant in the very fancy Aberdeen Centre, here on Lulu Island. I do not often have dim sum, and this time, I really had a nice time. My family knew that I have been dreaming of a spacious atrium-like venue, and this time, there it was. After the beautiful meal, we headed to the Japanese-lifestyle boutique called Oomomo. I wanted to get a bottle of authentic Japanese "mugicha," or barley tea, but I could not think too much of more food, just then.

jyutping: hai2 2023 nin4 4 jyut6 9 hou6，ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 zo2 go3 wai2 jyu1 lou6 lou6 dou2 fei1 soeng4 faa1 sik1 ge3 aa3 baak3 ding1 zung1 sam1 ge3 jau1 ngaa5 jyu4 jan4 lou6 toi4 hoi2 sin1 caan1 teng1 sik6 dim2 sam1 ng5 caan1。ngo5 m4 hai6 seng4 jat6 sik6 dim2 sam1，ji4 gam1 ci3，ngo5 zan1 hai6 gwo3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1。ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 zi1 dou3 ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 mung6 soeng2 jau5 go3 hou2 ci5 zung1 ting4 gam2 ge3 fun1 cong2 coeng4 dei6，ji4 gam1 ci3，zau6 hai6 go2 dou6。sik6 jyun4 leng3 caan1 zi1 hau6，ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 zo2 jat1 gaan1 giu3 zou6 Oomomo ge3 jat6 sik1 sang1 wut6 zing1 ban2 dim3。ngo5 soeng2 lo2 zeon1 zing3 zung1 ge3 jat6 bun2「 mugicha 」，waak6 ze2 daai6 mak6 caa4，daan6 hai6 ngo5 nam2 m4 dou2 taai3 do1 je5 sik6，zau6 hai2 go2 si4。
text: 喺2023年4月9號，我屋企人出去食咗個位於露露島非常花式嘅阿伯丁中心嘅優雅漁人露台海鮮餐廳食點心午餐。我唔係成日食點心，而今次，我真係過得好開心。我屋企人都知道我一直都夢想有個好似中庭噉嘅寬敞場地，而今次，就係嗰度。食完靚餐之後，我哋就去咗一間叫做 Oomomo 嘅日式生活精品店。我想攞樽正宗嘅日本「 mugicha 」，或者大麥茶，但係我諗唔到太多嘢食，就喺嗰時。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This is a vote the ramifications of which are going to last for many generations. We have to think very long-term here. Anyone with a sense of history knows that this country has fought bitterly to maintain its freedom and independence for nigh on a thousand years. My heart wants us to remain in Europe, but my head tells me I have no choice but to vote to leave. I'm going to vote with my head.

jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 tau4 piu3，keoi5 ge3 hau6 gwo2 zoeng1 wui5 ci4 zuk6 hou2 do1 doi6。ngo5 dei6 hai2 ni1 dou6 jiu3 hou2 coeng4 jyun5 gam2 nam2。 jau5 lik6 si2 gam2 ge3 jan4 dou1 zi1，ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 wai6 zo2 wai4 ci4 zi6 jau4 tung4 duk6 laap6 ji4 fu2 fu2 zin3 dau3 zo2 kan5 jat1 cin1 nin4。 ngo5 go3 sam1 soeng2 ngo5 dei6 lau4 hai2 au1 zau1，daan6 hai6 ngo5 go3 tau4 waa6 ngo5 zi1 ngo5 mou5 dak1 syun2 zaak6，zing6 hai6 ho2 ji5 tau4 piu3 lei4 hoi1。 ngo5 wui5 jung6 go3 tau4 tau4 piu3。
text: 呢個係一個投票，佢嘅後果將會持續好多代。我哋喺呢度要好長遠噉諗。 有歷史感嘅人都知，呢個國家為咗維持自由同獨立而苦苦戰鬥咗近一千年。 我個心想我哋留喺歐洲，但係我個頭話我知我冇得選擇，淨係可以投票離開。 我會用個頭投票。
